title: Finite bases and unique rank over a division ring
statement: Let $D$ be a division ring, meaning a nonzero unital ring in which every nonzero element is invertible. Let $V$ be a unital left $D$-module generated by finitely many elements [def-weil-finitely-generated-module]: there are $v_1,\ldots,v_r\in V$ such that every element of $V$ is a sum $\sum_{i=1}^r a_i v_i$ with $a_i\in D$. A basis has the unique-expression meaning of [def-weil-pbc-free-module]. Then there are an integer $n\geq0$ and elements $b_1,\ldots,b_n\in V$ such that every $v\in V$ has a unique expression $$v=\sum_{i=1}^n a_i b_i,\qquad a_i\in D.$$ If $b'_1,\ldots,b'_m$ is another family with this same unique-expression property, then $m=n$. The empty family is allowed when $V=0$.
